articles.text: Tesla (TSLA) Price Prediction: How Much a $10,000 Investment Could Be Worth by 2027. Tesla is stacking catalysts from Cybercab and Optimus to unsupervised robotaxi rides, but volatile fundamentals and a trailing P/E above 350 mean a $10,000 bet on TSLA could land almost anywhere by 2027.
